basics.name: Zide Fan
basics.label: Associate Professor
basics.summary: Associate Professor and Master's Supervisor at the Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences. Deputy Director of the Second Department. Research interests include aerospace big data intelligent processing, intelligent modeling and simulation, remote sensing image understanding, and trajectory prediction.

work.company: Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences
work.summary: Leading research in simulation and training technologies. Supervising master's students in Signal and Information Processing. Serving as principal investigator and chief designer for multiple major national projects.
highlights: Led 20+ research projects including CAS Strategic Priority A-class Program
Published 30+ SCI papers, 3 monographs, 30+ granted patents
Selected for CAS AIR 'Future Star' Talent Program (2022)
